12) Hence, the following order:-

ORDER I) In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with C.R. No. 150 of 2023, registered with Alankar Police Station, Pune, for the offences punishable under Section 406 and 420 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant be released on bail on executing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.

II) The applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and attend Alankar Police Station, Pune on 28th and 29th December, 2023 in between 10.00 am to 1.00 pm and, thereafter, as and when directed by the Investigating Officer.
